sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Live-cell surface immunofluorescence with anti-Flag antibody on non-permeabilized HEK 293T cells confirmed membrane-associated surface expression; olfactory receptor ligand-binding or signalling function was NOT MEASURED in this assay.
sites.rationale: OR52H1 is a GPCR-type olfactory receptor with no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place EC1 at residues 1–26, making the N-terminus extracellular. A prepend (insert_after_residue=0) places the tag before M1, with 26 aa of EC1 providing a buffer before TM1 begins at residue 27—well beyond the ≥3-residue TM-clearance constraint. The ledger (L1–L3, PMC3698168) documents N-terminal Flag tags on full-length, membrane-anchored ORs including OR52H1 family members, with surface display confirmed by live-cell immunofluorescence; L3 further shows the 8-aa Flag tag alone is sufficient for surface trafficking. Because no specific residue number is named in the ledger, the junction is topology-derived: for a GPCR N-terminus there is exactly one extracellular terminus, so insert_after_residue=0 is the unique valid position. PMC3698168 cloned olfactory receptors (including OR52H1 family members) with N-terminal Flag tags in full-length, membrane-anchored constructs expressed in HEK 293T cells; L3 specifically shows that two-thirds of Lucy-tagged ORs reach the cell surface with chaperones bearing only the 8-aa Flag tag on the mature protein, without the Rho tag.

sources.claim: In fact, two-thirds of Lucy-tagged ORs are able to reach the cell surface synergistically with chaperones even when the Rho tag is removed (10/15 ORs), allowing for the potential assessment of OR function with only an 8-amino acid Flag tag on the mature protein.

literature_notes: Three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) all derive from the same paper (PMC3698168) and all describe N-terminal Flag tagging of full-length membrane-anchored olfactory receptors, with OR52H1 family members explicitly included. No ledger line describes an internal loop insertion, a C-terminal tag, or any insertion in EC2 (89–99), EC3 (167–195), or EC4 (264–275) of OR52H1 or a close ortholog; those loops therefore yield no sites. The C-terminus (IC4: 297–314) is intracellular and cannot carry a surface tag. Confidence is medium rather than high because the ledger clips refer to 'OR52H1 family members' rather than naming OR52H1 itself by accession, making this indirect evidence; no specific residue number is cited, so position_evidence is topology_derived. The FLAG tag (8 aa, DYKDDDDK) is shorter than the 13–23 aa ALFA-tag range specified in the prompt, but it is the tag the ledger supports; the site geometry (26 aa EC1 buffer) is fully compatible with a longer ALFA-tag insert at the same junction.
